ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) base surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/light grey) focal clusters and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patch at the distal tip of the left lobe; multiple small circular high-contrast clusters distributed mid-lobe bilaterally; a prominent vertical high-intensity linear segment on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 85 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth extending toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile with pixel amplitudes varying significantly; deepest indentations located on the interior margins of the trailing edge adjacent to the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature rising from the waterline; trailing edges exhibit a generally linear trajectory with a slight concave pull toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular and annular white pixel clusters (0.5% to 2% of fluke area each) across the central ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Primary diagonal high-contrast linear mark on the right lobe approximately mid-way between notch and tip; secondary faint horizontal and diagonal scratches visible on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal white linear scar on the right lobe; significant irregular serration along the trailing edge indicative of physical wear or trauma; high-density barnacle colonization scars.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity pixel spray and atmospheric glare at the distal tips of both lobes caused by water displacement, obscuring fine edge detail at the extremities.
